_warning: Single source of truth for per-VM protection tuning. Consumed by: load-shedder.nix, tier1-apps.nix, health-agent.nix via builtins.fromJSON. Edit here + redeploy to tune — never edit inline in .nix files.

defaults._comment: Applied to any VM not listed in vm_overrides

oci-mail._comment: Mail stack — maddy+stalwart are tier-1, must survive shed

oci-apps._comment: App VM — no tier-1 apps (all can be shed); higher threshold due to build activity

oci-analytics._comment: Analytics VM — umami/matomo can be shed freely
